Subject: Administrative arrangements in the Zones for convening of
Departmental Promotion Committee meetings — regarding.

Sir,

Consequent to the Notification of the Recruitment Rules for different cadres,
Addl. CPFCs in the Zones have to fill up all the posts relating to Examination Quota as well as
Seniority Quota. In this connection, instructions have already been issued to the Zonal
Addl. CPFCs to convene the DPCs for the EO/AO cadre also upon declaration of the results of
the Examination Quota vacancies.

2. To carry out the above task relating to convening of DPCs, administrative
difficulties being faced in the field office have been noticed as there are some Zones where
no ACC has been posted and existing Addl. CPFCs are holding more than one additional
charge. Hence, it has been decided to authorize the senior most RPFC-I in Regional Office in
the vacant Zones where no ACC is posted, who will chair the various DPCs for the purposes
of promotion etc.

3. Accordingly, the following arrangements have been decided in respect of the
Zones where no ACC has been posted:
S.N. Zone Name of RPFC-I to chair DPCs
1 ACC (Andhra Pradesh), Shri P. Veerabhadra Swamy, RPFC-I, Guntur
Vijayawada

2 ACC (Telengana), Hyderabad | Shri MSKVV Satyanarayana, RPFC-I, Hyderabad

3 ACC (Chennai & Puducherry), | Shri D. Remmei, RPFC-I, Tambaram.
Chennai

4. Further, it is once again reiterated to ensure that DPCs may be convened at the
earliest and complete proposal consisting of the proceedings of the DPCs with the requisite
documents to be sent to Headquarters for approval of the Competent Authority.

5. This issues with the approval of Central P.F. Commissioner.
Yours faithfully,
wv A

(K.V. Sarveswaran)
Addl. Central P.F. Commissioner (HQ(HR)
